review_notes: I read the whole file. Its only new definition is `leviQuadratic`, a complex quadratic coefficient built from a real bilinear form B along a complex line: (B w w − B(Iw)(Iw))/4 − (I/2)·B w (I w). It is a specialised construction for the Levi polynomial, and I found no Mathlib concept that represents it. I searched this library for other uses: it appears only here and in `Peak.lean`, and I did not find a second definition of it. Every other declaration is a theorem (defining-function distance bounds, the disc estimate, the Levi theorem, transport along a continuous linear equivalence). The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, so I did not assess those. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for a similar sesquilinear or Hermitian-part construction. I judged a competing-concept finding unjustified.
